prompts.purpose: Shortest possible request. Uses part of one block.
Single token answer. Finds off-by-one bugs in the first decode step.
prompts.text: What is 2 + 2? Answer with a number only.

prompts.purpose: Target: prompt ends exactly on a block boundary. Adjust with the pad script.
prompts.text: List three primary colors in a single short sentence with no extra words.

prompts.purpose: Target: prompt ends one token before a block boundary. Tests the last slot in a block.
prompts.text: Name the largest ocean on Earth and stop.

prompts.purpose: Target: prompt ends one token after a block boundary. Forces a new block for one token.
prompts.text: Give the capital city of Japan in one word plus a short note.

prompts.purpose: Output crosses a block boundary during decode. Tests block allocation mid-generation.
prompts.text: Count from one to thirty using words, separated by commas.

prompts.purpose: Prompt spans several blocks. Tests block table indexing beyond the first entry.
prompts.text: Here is a description of a system. A web server receives requests from users. Each request is placed into a queue. A background worker removes requests from the queue one at a time. The worker calls a model, waits for the result, and returns the result to the user. The queue has a maximum size. When the queue is full, new requests are rejected with an error. Summarize this system in two sentences.

prompts.purpose: Long prompt, very short answer. Stresses prefill relative to decode.
prompts.text: Read the following list of animals: dog, cat, horse, cow, sheep, goat, pig, duck, goose, chicken, rabbit, donkey, llama, alpaca, turkey, pigeon, parrot, hamster, ferret, mouse, rat, gerbil, canary, finch, budgie, tortoise, lizard, snake, frog, newt. How many animals are in this list? Answer with a number only.
prompts.note: The correct answer is 30. The small model may get this wrong. That does not matter. Only consistency matters.

prompts.purpose: Structured output. Long and repetitive. Easy to spot corruption by eye.
prompts.text: Write a numbered list of the first eight even numbers. Put each number on its own line in the format 'N. value'.

prompts.purpose: Prefix group member 1 of 3. Same system text, different ending.
prompts.system: You are a precise assistant. Answer briefly. Never add extra commentary. Never apologize. Never ask follow-up questions. Give only the direct answer to the question asked.
prompts.text: What is the boiling point of water in Celsius?

prompts.purpose: Prefix group member 2 of 3. Must share blocks with p10 once prefix caching exists.
prompts.system: You are a precise assistant. Answer briefly. Never add extra commentary. Never apologize. Never ask follow-up questions. Give only the direct answer to the question asked.
prompts.text: What is the chemical symbol for iron?

prompts.purpose: Prefix group member 3 of 3. Longer unique part than p10 and p11.
prompts.system: You are a precise assistant. Answer briefly. Never add extra commentary. Never apologize. Never ask follow-up questions. Give only the direct answer to the question asked.
prompts.text: List the four seasons of the year in the order they occur, starting with spring.

prompts.purpose: Many output tokens. Tests repeated block allocation during decode.
prompts.text: Explain how a queue works in a computer program. Describe adding items, removing items, and what happens when the queue is full. Write about six sentences.

prompts.purpose: Forced exact output length. Ignores the stop token.
prompts.text: Describe the water cycle in simple words.

prompts.purpose: Non-Latin script. Tests tokenizer handling and byte-level output.
prompts.text: Translate this sentence into English: 今天天气很好，我想去公园散步。

prompts.purpose: Emoji and accents. Multi-byte characters can split across streaming chunks.
prompts.text: Repeat this text exactly, then add one short comment: café ☕ naïve résumé 🚀 Ω≈ç√

prompts.purpose: Code output. Whitespace and newlines must survive streaming without changes.
prompts.text: Write a Python function named add that takes two arguments and returns their sum. Include no explanation.

prompts.purpose: Highly repetitive output. A KV corruption bug often shows here as a broken pattern.
prompts.text: Repeat the word 'block' fifty times, separated by spaces.

prompts.purpose: Prompt is a single character. Tests the shortest valid prefill.
Very long prompt, one output token. Worst case for prefill blocking decode.
